title: Muqaddimat Ibn al-Salah
author: ibn-al-salah
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Ibn al-Salah's survey of the sciences of hadith in sixty-five chapters, from the sound and the weak report through the conditions of transmission, the criticism of narrators, the writing and reading of hadith, and the terminology of the discipline. It became the standard introduction to hadith methodology and the base of al-Nawawi's Irshad and later abridgements.
historicalContext: Written in Damascus in the last years of Ibn al-Salah's life, when he taught at the Ashrafiyya school. The work fixed the vocabulary of hadith criticism for later Sunni scholarship, and its categories are still taught in traditional hadith curricula.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
